# Embedded font fixture

`source.pptx` declares and embeds the regular and bold faces of **Be Vietnam
Pro** as `ppt/fonts/BeVietnamPro-regular.fntdata` and
`BeVietnamPro-bold.fntdata` (EOT containers, MicroType Express compressed).
It exercises the embedded-font path in `test/embed-font.mjs`.

The font is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; `OFL.txt` is its
licence. The deck is used read only.
